Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 19 October 2026 19 October 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 12 October 2026 to 16 October 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 12 Oct 2026 826,446 292.0000 286.8000 288.8321 LSE 13 Oct 2026 823,610 298.6000 290.4000 294.3132 LSE 14 Oct 2026 643,989 305.5000 293.5000 300.0315 LSE 15 Oct 2026 638,864 312.6000 303.2000 308.5222 LSE 16 Oct 2026 629,032 312.0000 307.7000 309.5697 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 33,937,763 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,376,582,490 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,376,582,490.
